risk_event: Recall@10 < 0.95; with k=10 this is hit_count < 10
unresolved_source_action: endpoint with an explicit unresolved flag

inference.primary_unit: shared query ID retaining its complete directed source-target pair vector
sensitivities: LOBO drops the same build from source and target roles

cost_rules.hnswlib: report stored per-query NDC and native action
cost_rules.faiss_hnsw: report native action; NDC stays NDC_NOT_ESTIMABLE_BATCH_CUMULATIVE unless a new valid counter replay is separately authorized

interpretation_rules.broad_gap: +2 incremental risk >= 0.05 and query-cluster 95 percent lower bound > 0
interpretation_rules.tradeoff: risk decreases but valid cost is unresolved or materially increases
interpretation_rules.mixed: different dataset/operator decisions or no monotone slack response

forbidden: treating directed pairs as independent builds
